events.event: XXXLutz and Porta publicly announce the agreed sale, expressly subject to competition approval.
The European Commission opens a formal investigation into possible gun jumping; the opening does not prejudge the outcome.
The concentration is formally notified as case M.11895; Phase I is ongoing and the provisional deadline is 2026-10-12.
The published party submission states that XXXLutz KG intends to acquire sole control over the Porta group.
No clearance decision, closing or control transfer is bound in the public source set.
